ui.todayHint: Lessons, homework and what's coming up.
ui.setupTimetable: Your timetable is empty — fill it in under Timetable.
ui.weekHint: Click a period, then a subject on the right. Arrow keys move, Delete clears.
ui.taskPh: What is there to do? e.g. p. 34 no. 5
ui.datesHint: Exams, tests, presentations and deadlines — with a countdown.
ui.subjectsHint: Name, color, teacher and room of each subject.
ui.selectHint: Select a homework, a date, a subject or a timetable period to see and change it here.
ui.cellHint: Pick the subject of this period.
ui.title: Title
ui.subject: Subject
ui.eventNotesPh: What to learn, what to bring…
ui.name: Name
toast.appOnly: The calendar export works in the installed app.
toast.notPlan: “{name}” is not a Plan Studio plan.
toast.loadFail: Your plan could not be read: {e}
confirm.deleteSubject: This subject is used in the timetable, homework or dates. Delete it anyway?
confirm.import: Replace your plan with “{name}”? (Undo brings it back.)
confirm.title: Plan Studio
about.p1: Plan Studio is part of the Studio family: offline tools for school and university, without an account.
about.p2: Your plan is saved on this PC only. Back it up with File → Save Backup, and put dates into any calendar with File → Export to Calendar.
set.title: Settings
set.languageHint: The language of menus and dialogs.
set.panels: Show the panels on the right
set.autoHide: Auto-hide bars (they slide in at the screen edge)
set.periodsHint: Start and end of each period. A gap of 15 minutes or more shows as a break.
keys.hint: Click a shortcut and press the new keys. Backspace removes it, Esc cancels.
keys.needMod: Use Ctrl or Alt (or a function key).
keys.taken: {k} was used by “{a}” — that one has no shortcut now.
keys.fixed: {k} belongs to “{a}” and can't be changed.
cal.intro: Link Google, Apple or Outlook calendars to see their events here.
cal.nothing: No events in the next 7 days.
cal.hint: Events of linked calendars are shown in Today and in the next 7 days. They are read-only and refresh at start and every 30 minutes; the last state stays available offline.
cal.badUrl: Paste a calendar address starting with https:// or webcal://.
cal.appOnly: Linking calendars works in the installed app.
cal.howTitle: Where do I find the address?
cal.howGoogle: calendar.google.com → Settings → your calendar → “Integrate calendar” → copy “Secret address in iCal format”.
cal.howApple: In the Calendar app (or icloud.com) share the calendar, turn on “Public Calendar” and copy the webcal:// link.
cal.howOutlook: outlook.com → Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars → “Publish a calendar” → copy the ICS link.
cal.secret: Keep the address secret: anyone who has it can read the calendar. Plan Studio stores it on this computer only and leaves it out of backups.
tt.groupHint: Subjects in the same elective area form a catalog. A timetable slot of that area is chosen from it.
tt.cellTermsHint: A slot can hold different courses for different terms (Settings → Timetable → Terms). The timetable shows the courses of the week you are looking at.
set.termsHint: Half-years, quarters or blocks. Courses in the timetable can apply to some of them only, e.g. electives you choose anew each quarter.
tt.wtHint: The week type of this week: from the pattern, or set by hand for this week only (the weeks after it stay as they are).
tt.ownTimeHint: Leave empty for the period's time ({start}–{end}).
area.noOffers: No offers for this slot yet — add them in Subjects or Settings → Elective areas.
area.pickedHint: Chosen for this date only. "Same every week" keeps it for all weeks (for offers with regular attendance).
area.fixedHint: Chosen for all weeks ("Same every week"); pick something else to change it for this date only.
area.weeklyHint: This area is chosen anew every week: pick an offer for this date.
area.offeredHint: None ticked = in every slot of this area.
area.weekly: Chosen anew every week (each date on its own)
area.intro: Areas come from the subjects' "Elective area". For each you can set how it is chosen, a deadline and a rule; Today reminds you of open choices.
area.none: No elective areas yet. Give subjects an elective area (in the subject's details).
set.holidaysHint: No lessons on these days (class sessions and dates still show).
set.weekTypesHint: For A/B weeks: the pattern the weeks follow, separated by commas — e.g. A, B or A, A, B. Lessons and offers can then apply in one week type only. Single weeks can be changed in the timetable.
set.skipHolidayWeeks: Holiday weeks don't count (the rhythm continues after the holidays)
set.icsWeeksHint: The calendar export can also contain your timetable (with holidays, alternating weeks and your choices):
area.modeHint: Applies to the whole elective area
mycal.whatHint: Dates and exams always; homework and the timetable if you like. The same applies to the calendar file (File → Export Calendar).
mycal.icloud: iCloud calendar (also on iPhone and iPad)
mycal.icloudHint: Plan Studio writes its entries into a calendar "Plan Studio" in your iCloud account and keeps it up to date after every change.
mycal.passHint: Not your normal password: create an app-specific password at account.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords. It is kept on this computer only, and you can revoke it there at any time.
mycal.connected: Connected — your entries are being uploaded.
mycal.synced: Calendar up to date ({n} uploaded, {d} removed).
mycal.disconnectAsk: Forget the iCloud account on this computer? The calendar "Plan Studio" stays in iCloud (you can delete it in the Calendar app).
mycal.needBoth: Enter your Apple ID and the app-specific password.
mycal.signinFail: Sign-in failed — check the Apple ID and the app-specific password.
mycal.feedHint: Without an account: calendar apps on this computer (Apple Calendar, Outlook, Thunderbird) subscribe to Plan Studio and refresh by themselves — while Plan Studio is running, and only on this computer.
mycal.feedOn: Offer the plan as a calendar subscription
mycal.feedHow: Apple Calendar opens the subscription dialog by itself. Outlook: Add calendar → From Internet → paste the link. Thunderbird: New Calendar → On the Network → paste the link.
mycal.appOnly: This works in the installed app.
grade.hint: Your grades per subject, with weighted averages.
grade.none: No grades yet — add one above, or from an exam under Dates.
grade.bad: That is not a grade in your grade system.
grade.calcHint: Choose subject, category and the average you want: you see what the next grade there has to be.
grade.calcNeed: The next grade needs to be {g} (or better).
grade.calcSafe: You reach it with any grade.
grade.subjectWeightsHint: Empty = as set under Settings → Grades.
grade.plusHint: How much a 2+ or 2− differs from a 2 — as your school counts it.
grade.catsHint: E.g. written 50 %, oral 50 % — or what your school uses. Per subject the weights can differ (in the subject's details).
grade.sumHint: The weights add up to {n} % — they are taken in proportion.
grade.delCatAsk: Grades of this category then count in the first category. Remove it?
set.blockedHint: Click a slot to block it: no lessons there (e.g. Saturday afternoon). Click again to free it.
